heading: Access to a choice of qualified prescription drug coverage

tree.heading: Assuring access to a choice of coverage

children.heading: Choice of at least two plans in each area
children.text: The Secretary shall ensure that each part D eligible individual has available, consistent with paragraph (2), a choice of enrollment in at least 2 qualifying plans (as defined in paragraph (3)) in the area in which the individual resides, at least one of which is a prescription drug plan. In any such case in which such plans are not available, the part D eligible individual shall be given the opportunity to enroll in a fallback prescription drug plan.

children.heading: Requirement for different plan sponsors
children.text: The requirement in paragraph (1) is not satisfied with respect to an area if only one entity offers all the qualifying plans in the area.

children.heading: Qualifying plan defined
children.text: For purposes of this section, the term “qualifying plan” means—
an MA–PD plan described in section 1395w–21(a)(2)(A)(i) of this title that provides—

qualified prescription drug coverage that provides supplemental prescription drug coverage so long as there is no MA monthly supplemental beneficiary premium applied under the plan, due to the application of a credit against such premium of a rebate under section 1395w–24(b)(1)(C) of this title.

tree.heading: Flexibility in risk assumed and application of fallback plan
tree.text: In order to ensure access pursuant to subsection (a) in an area—

children.text: the Secretary may approve limited risk plans under section 1395w–111(f) of this title for the area; and

only if such access is still not provided in the area after applying paragraph (1), the Secretary shall provide for the offering of a fallback prescription drug plan for that area under section 1395w–111(g) of this title.
